title: Codex and OpenCode plugin setup
summary: Add Codex/OpenCode setup commands and plugin bundles with planner routing.
description: Implement current Codex and OpenCode harness setup/plugin support without coupling planner core to either harness. Current state: packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts has setup claude-code and a stale setup codex that writes .codex/mcp.json; plugins/codex/README.md is only a placeholder; plugins/claude-code/ and scripts/sync-plugins.cjs provide the existing shared skill/template pattern; docs/setup-codex.md and README.md describe older Codex behavior. Desired state: setup codex writes current Codex config.toml MCP configuration and installs/discovers the Agent Plan plugin/skill where supported; setup opencode creates project/user OpenCode config for @agent-plan/mcp and /planner command routing; plugin bundles under plugins/codex and plugins/opencode reuse the canonical planner guide. Preserve harness-agnostic core boundaries: do not move planner business logic out of @agent-plan/mcp/@agent-plan/core, and document any harness limitation such as Codex slash-command autosuggestion if not exposed by public APIs.

acceptedDecisions.title: Codex uses MCP plus skill instead of custom slash command
acceptedDecisions.decision: Codex support ships as MCP configuration plus an agent-plan skill/plugin bundle. Agent Plan must not claim Codex has a native custom /planner slash command or nested autosuggestion until Codex exposes a public API for it.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Current Codex CLI/plugin surfaces expose MCP servers, plugins, and skills, but no documented custom slash-command registration surface. Promising /planner in Codex would mislead users.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: agent-plan setup codex writes .codex/config.toml, .codex/skills/agent-plan/SKILL.md, and .codex/skills/planner/SKILL.md. For user scope it also registers and installs the Codex marketplace plugin when the codex CLI is available. plugins/codex ships plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, mcp.json/.mcp.json, the generated agent-plan skill, and a generated planner alias skill; the repo-root .agents/plugins/marketplace.json exposes it to codex plugin marketplace. Handoff reads keep the persisted capsule in tool text and also expose bounded structured content for hosts that rely on structuredContent.

acceptedDecisions.title: OpenCode gets compact /planner plus slash-path autosuggest aliases
acceptedDecisions.decision: OpenCode support uses mcp.servers.agent-plan plus a compact command.planner entry for /planner arguments. Setup also installs slash-path aliases such as planner/web/start for command-list autosuggestion, with hyphenated aliases preserved only for compatibility.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: OpenCode v2 command configuration accepts named command templates and shows command names in autocomplete, but does not expose documented space-separated segment completion for a single /planner command. Slash-path command names match OpenCode nested command discovery while avoiding a long planner guide prompt on every invocation.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: agent-plan setup opencode writes opencode.json or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json with command.planner, nested aliases such as planner/load, planner/task/start, and planner/web/status, and compatibility aliases such as planner-load. The generated templates route to MCP tools and reference the installed skill or .planner/SKILL.md only when deeper routing context is needed; they no longer embed the full canonical guide on every command.

tasks.description:

tasks.title: Fix Codex marketplace install and OpenCode command registration
tasks.description:
Correct the Codex/OpenCode setup slice after real harness verification found two user-visible gaps. Codex setup must make the Agent Plan plugin visible through the Codex plugin marketplace instead of only copying a skill file. OpenCode setup must write slash commands under the documented singular command key, not the ignored legacy commands key. Preserve MCP registration, --force, --local, user/project scope behavior, and the Codex limitation that no custom /planner slash command is exposed by the public plugin/config surface.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented the corrective setup pass. Added .agents/plugins/marketplace.json so Codex can discover plugins/codex as a marketplace plugin. Updated agent-plan setup codex so user-scope setup registers and installs agent-plan@agent-plan through codex plugin marketplace, with local checkout support for --local and manual fallback text on failure. Updated agent-plan setup opencode to write command.planner plus flat aliases under OpenCode's documented command key and remove stale Agent Plan entries from legacy commands on --force. Updated release scripts to bump the Codex marketplace catalog version alongside plugin manifests. Updated README, setup docs, plugin docs, and decisions. Verification: built @agent-plan/core, @agent-plan/server, @agent-plan/mcp, and agent-plan; pnpm --filter agent-plan check passed; node --test packages/agent-plan/test/version.test.mjs passed 9/9; pnpm plugins:check passed; node --check passed for release.cjs, release-next.cjs, and sync-plugins.cjs; Codex marketplace local smoke passed with a temporary HOME and did not touch the user's ~/.codex.

tasks.title: Fix OpenCode compact command prompts and slash-path autosuggestion
tasks.description: Post-release correction for the OpenCode setup after real usage showed two problems: /planner was suggested but space-separated subcommands were not discoverable, and every invocation injected the full Agent Plan operating guide. The fix keeps /planner routing, adds slash-path aliases such as /planner/web/start and /planner/task/start for OpenCode command-list autocomplete, preserves hyphenated aliases for compatibility, and makes command templates compact by referencing the installed skill or .planner/SKILL.md only when deeper routing context is needed.

tasks.title: Fix Codex handoff body routing and planner skill alias
tasks.description: Post-release correction after Codex usage in heca-pro showed an agent misread planner-handoff-show as returning only phase identifiers. Reproduced the real MCP response: SDK clients receive content text and structured text; Codex CLI exposes the full text body but only minimal structured keys. The fix keeps the handoff body in tool text, adds bounded structured content for structuredContent-only hosts, clarifies the skill instructions to read text first and use raw storage only as an explicit diagnostic fallback, and installs a planner skill alias so $planner appears in Codex suggestions.
